The chain rule for a multivariable function $f(x,y)$ with two independent variables $s$ and $t,$ where $x=x(s,t)$ and $y=y(s,t),$ can be expressed as follows:

$$
\frac{∂f}{∂t}=\frac{∂f}{∂x}\cdot \frac{∂x}{∂t}+\frac{∂f}{∂y}\cdot \frac{∂y}{∂t}
$$

First, we find the partial derivatives of $f$ with respect to $x$ and $y:$ 

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂f}{∂x} &=1,\,\frac{∂f}{∂y}=-3\end{aligned}
$$

Writing the above results in terms of $s$ and $t,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂f}{∂x} & =1, \\ \frac{∂f}{∂y} & =-3.\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we take the derivatives of $x$ and $y$ with respect to $t,$ and we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂x}{∂t} & =2, \\ \frac{∂y}{∂t} & =1.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, substituting all of our derivatives into the multivariable chain rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂f}{∂t} & =\frac{∂f}{∂x}\cdot \frac{∂x}{∂t}+\frac{∂f}{∂y}\cdot \frac{∂y}{∂t} \\  & =(1)\cdot (2)+(-3)\cdot (1) \\  & =(2)+(-3) \\  & =-1.\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy :question/answer-fields ["e9d99e66-e5d7-5abb-90a0-6ef8b10366af"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "ab4a36cf-8e37-5c93-a940-f0483cf5585c" :answer/id #uuid "ab4a36cf-8e37-5c93-a940-f0483cf5585c" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-3" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "fff834ab-7560-57a6-8624-61aa2b610321" :answer/id #uuid "fff834ab-7560-57a6-8624-61aa2b610321" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-5" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "dff6d51e-e337-532f-aed0-37556ebd5e74" :answer/id #uuid "dff6d51e-e337-532f-aed0-37556ebd5e74" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-6" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "d69ac37c-d730-5d76-b437-fb1d07fc8bef" :answer/id #uuid "d69ac37c-d730-5d76-b437-fb1d07fc8bef" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-12" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "7aa3f9a6-4770-56b8-aca0-b568327ac0c3" :answer/id #uuid "7aa3f9a6-4770-56b8-aca0-b568327ac0c3" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-9" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "3173d599-6bd0-5276-9811-269b4d168705" :answer-field/id #uuid "3173d599-6bd0-5276-9811-269b4d168705" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/choices ["ab4a36cf-8e37-5c93-a940-f0483cf5585c" "fff834ab-7560-57a6-8624-61aa2b610321" "dff6d51e-e337-532f-aed0-37556ebd5e74" "d69ac37c-d730-5d76-b437-fb1d07fc8bef" "7aa3f9a6-4770-56b8-aca0-b568327ac0c3"] :answer-field/correct "d69ac37c-d730-5d76-b437-fb1d07fc8bef" :db/ensure :answer-field/validate} {:db/id "4a433498-d0db-5e2d-80cc-422f4772f109" :question/id #uuid "4a433498-d0db-5e2d-80cc-422f4772f109" :question/problem "Let $f(x,y)=3 x + y,$ where $x=- 2 s - 3 t$ and $y=s - 3 t.$ Calculate $\frac{∂f}{∂t}.$" :question/worked-solution "![](images/11/118759b163a4410f66d5855d7b7b1fd9c2ee4be585e778a759997036bd95f765.png)
